name: Walking
description:
Walking routes, groomed winter trails, low-tide hikes and the best walks in Stratford.

The Navigation tab finds a walking route between two places. Type an address, tap the map, or start from your location. Quiet streets keeps you away from the busy streets, the Trans Canada Highway and Stratford, Bunbury, Keppoch, Kinlock, Georgetown, Hopeton, and Jubilee roads, including the sidewalks right beside them. Sidewalks and trails keeps you off streets with no sidewalk. Any ignores the setting, Prefer takes a reasonable detour to follow it, and Only follows it strictly.

When no route can follow an Only setting, the map shows the closest one and marks the stretches that break it in red, which shows where the walking network has gaps.

If you notice anything strange or any gaps, let me know.

properties.name: Fullerton's Creek Conservation Park
properties.description: Ranked as Stratford’s top walking destination, Fullerton’s Creek Conservation Park features over 4 km of packed gravel trails winding through peaceful woodlands and open meadows. Walkers can start from the main parking lot at the end of MacIntosh Drive or enter from Mount Herbert Road, with well-maintained paths suitable for all skill levels and even cleared for winter use. A scenic lookout platform offers a sweeping view of the marsh, where visitors often spot herons, ducks, and other local wildlife.
